cd /workspace/submission/src && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, pathlib, subprocess

frames = ["NewConnectionIdFrame","MaxDataFrame","StopSendingFrame","MaxStreamsFrame","ResetStreamFrame",
          "MaxStreamDataFrame","StreamDataBlockedFrame","StreamsBlockedFrame","DatagramFrame",
          "RetireConnectionIdFrame","DataBlockedFrame","PathChallengeFrame","PathResponseFrame",
          "NewTokenFrame","CryptoFrame","HandshakeDoneFrame","ConnectionCloseFrame","PingFrame","PaddingFrame"]

def widen_frame(p):
    s=open(p).read()
    orig=s
    # field declarations
    s=s.replace("@ModifiableVariableProperty protected ModifiableInteger","@ModifiableVariableProperty protected ModifiableLong")
    # config fields
    s=re.sub(r"private int (\w*[Cc]onfig);", r"private long \1;", s)
    # getters/setters for modifiable fields
    s=s.replace("public ModifiableInteger get","public ModifiableLong get")
    s=re.sub(r"public void set(\w+)\(int (\w+)\) \{\n(\s*)this\.\2 = ModifiableVariableFactory\.safelySetValue\(this\.\2, \2\);",
             r"public void set\1(long \2) {\n\3this.\2 = ModifiableVariableFactory.safelySetValue(this.\2, \2);", s)
    # config getters/setters
    s=re.sub(r"public int get(\w*[Cc]onfig)\(\) \{", r"public long get\1() {", s)
    s=re.sub(r"public void set(\w*[Cc]onfig)\(int (\w+)\) \{", r"public void set\1(long \2) {", s)
    if "ModifiableInteger" in s:
        s=s.replace("import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.integer.ModifiableInteger;\n","")
        if "ModifiableLong" not in s:
            s=s.replace("import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.ModifiableVariableProperty;","import de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.ModifiableVariableProperty;\nimport de.rub.nds.modifiablevariable.longint.ModifiableLong;")
    if s!=orig: open(p,'w').write(s)
    return orig!=s

changed=0
for name in frames:
    p='de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/frame/%s.java'%name
    try: changed += 1 if widen_frame(p) else 0
    except FileNotFoundError: print('missing',name)
print('frames changed',changed)

import glob
for p in glob.glob('de/rub/nds/tlsattacker/core/quic/parser/frame/*.java'):
    s=open(p).read(); o=s
    s=s.replace("((int) parseVariableLengthInteger())","parseVariableLengthInteger()")
    s=re.sub(r"\(int\) parseVariableLengthInteger\(\)","parseVariableLengthInteger()",s)
    if s!=o: open(p,'w').write(s); print('parser widened',p)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 build.py /workspace/submission/src /workspace/tmp/classes 2>&1 | head -20
